title: Stress Testing 6 Completely Different Gravel Bikes to Find the Future of Gravel
content:
In episode 2 of the Velo Gravel Field Test, we put our 6 test bikes through 3 rounds of head to head challenges: climbing, descending, and efficiency.

Read the full article at Stress Testing 6 Completely Different Gravel Bikes to Find the Future of Gravel on Velo.
author: Will Tracy
